result:
Done! I've removed the 3MB `assets/sample.bin` binary file completely from git history using `git filter-repo`, then ran aggressive garbage collection.

**What was fixed:**
- The binary file was added in commit c69c3dc and deleted later, but still existed in git history (making clones large)
- Used `git filter-repo --invert-paths --path assets/sample.bin` to rewrite history and eliminate it from all commits
- Ran `git gc --aggressive --prune=now` to compact the repository

The file no longer appears anywhere in the commit history. New clones will be significantly smaller. Note: if this repository is shared, everyone will need to re-clone since the history has been rewritten.
